title: Steering wheel design, comfort, and heating
summary: Feedback centers on steering wheel design and feel, heated wheel comfort, and some complaints about missing button functions and heating performance, while many excerpts are too descriptive or incomplete to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the steering wheel’s design, feel in hand, and the inclusion or comfort of the heated steering wheel.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on missing steering wheel button functions and dissatisfaction with heated steering wheel warmth or warm-up behavior.

mixed.summary: The mixed review likes prior physical volume controls but criticizes the current steering wheel volume scroll wheel experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention steering wheel buttons, movement, appearance, heating expectations, or assistance feedback without enough context to confirm sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled excerpts are undetermined or truncated, which limits confidence about the balance of opinions within this topic.
One example assigned positive contains negative-sounding fragment text, so sentiment labeling and fragment wording are not always aligned in the sample.
The topic combines several related but distinct subtopics, including steering wheel design, controls, heating, and steering-wheel movement or assistance feedback.
